issues.where: encoded sky and far-ground crops, especially left of the growing tip and above the horizon
issues.what: Continuous diagonal rain streaks break into short, ragged dashes, and the cloud tones behind them group into blocky patches.
issues.fix: Give the rain shot more bits within the 5 Mbit/s encode using two-pass allocation and a slower preset. If needed, make the thinnest rain streaks slightly wider and less numerous.

issues.where: encoded growing-tip and far-ground crops, behind the central sunflower
issues.what: Smaller flower heads and the foliage between them merge into smeared patches. The central flower still reads, but some of its seed-head and petal texture is visibly softened.
issues.fix: Allocate more bits to the dense field shot and tune adaptive quantization to retain separate petal, stem, and leaf edges.

issues.where: encoded sky crop, in the gold haze below and to either side of the sun
issues.what: The halo still reads, but the transition from the gold haze into the field breaks into soft rectangular patches instead of a smooth falloff.
issues.fix: Reduce quantization in the low-contrast glow and verify that the halo fades smoothly in the 5 Mbit/s test.

issues.where: encoded sky crop, in the open blue sky to the right of the Milky Way above the plant tip
issues.what: Some faint stars that read as separate points before encoding soften into the background or disappear, leaving the star field visibly thinner in places.
issues.fix: Preserve more detail in the dark sky through adaptive quantization, or give the faintest intended stars slightly broader cores so they survive the encode.
